decision_record.question: What do the T03 evidence and each mandatory learner's API actually require, before any transform is written?
evidence_considered: T03-A ED-01: zero missing values across all twelve features on the full released population
docs/06 Stage 0 item 3 / frozen rule: preserve missing f0-f11 for LightGBM native handling; no imputation, no missingness-indicator feature
D17: LightGBM is the shared base-learner family for Response, T-Learner, and X-Learner
Causal Forest's exact implementation remains PROVISIONAL (ADR-CF-implementation); no estimator-specific requirement exists yet to react to
decision_record.decision: No-op preprocessing. X stays exactly the ordered f0-f11 columns at float64. No transform is fit beyond an explicit identity selection, which exists only to enforce and test the column/dtype/fit-boundary contract.
decision_record.why_not_more: Nothing in the current evidence or in any implemented learner's API requires imputation, scaling, encoding, or a missingness indicator. Adding one now would be preprocessing for tidiness, not for a concrete requirement, which Issue #5 explicitly prohibits.
decision_record.estimator_specific_branches: None yet. A branch is added only if a future learner's API genuinely cannot accept this shared float64 representation; none does today because no learner is implemented.

held_out_application_rule: apply the identical fitted (no-op) transform to held-out features at T17; no refitting, no held-out-informed adjustment

lifecycle_state_evidence.checklist_verified: T04.1 through T04.8 (Issue #5): decision record written before implementation, no-op contract implemented and content-hashed, fit-on-train-only boundary verified against the real 9,785,714-row train / 2,096,938-row validation split, column order/dtype/determinism/missing-value-passthrough verified on real data, held-out never accessed
lifecycle_state_evidence.note: T04 accepted independently, per Issue #5 DoD. Held-out application rule is frozen but not executed until T17.
